App.title: Garmin to SSI Converter
App.description: Convert Garmin .fit dive logs into an SSI-ready QR code for easy import.

Home.heading: Garmin to SSI Converter
Home.intro: Upload Garmin .fit dive logs to generate an SSI app QR code.

guide.link: How to export .fit from Garmin Connect
guide.title: Export .fit from Garmin Connect

steps.step1: Sign in to Garmin Connect on the web
steps.step2: Go to 'Diving' tab on the left
steps.step3: Click 'View Details' on the dive you want to export
steps.step4_1: (Top right if you are using desktop, above the graph if you are using mobile)
steps.step6: A .fit file will be downloaded to your device

importGuide.link: How to import QR Code in SSI app
importGuide.title: Import dive data in SSI app

steps.step2: Click (+) → Add Dive → Scan Dive QR Code
steps.step4: New Dive page is opened with prefill data, manual fill in the rest
